title: Brood Pattern
rules_text: Whelps close the lanes. Leave one standing and Embermaw feeds on it.

instant_beats.title: Raking Claw
instant_beats.rules_text: Target: Tank. Deal 4 damage. Movement does not evade this hit. An unheld Guarded Front suffers +3.

incoming_beats.title: Within Reach
incoming_beats.rules_text: If no hero stands adjacent to Embermaw at the end of this Round, Escalation rises by 1.

incoming_beats.title: Brood Call
incoming_beats.rules_text: Whelps emerge at the marked edge hexes. Any Whelp still standing at the next Round end raises Escalation by 1.

incoming_beats.title: Cull the Brood
incoming_beats.rules_text: A living Whelp is what pulls the collapse forward.
